MCP_REPO_ROOT.description: Absolute path to the local repo checkout. Required unless MCP_TELEGRAPH_ROOT is provided.

MCP_REPO_LABEL.description: Text label used in the prompts. Defaults to the basename of the repo root.

MCP_URI_SCHEME.description: Resource URI scheme. Defaults to the tool prefix if not specified.

MCP_TOOL_PREFIX.description: Tool name prefix used for the MCP tools.

MCP_GIT_AUTO_FETCH.description: If set to 1, runs git fetch --prune --tags once at server start.

MCP_MAX_FILE_BYTES.description: Maximum size of a file allowed to be read.

MCP_TELEGRAPH_ROOT.description: Legacy fallback for MCP_REPO_ROOT. Absolute path to the local repo checkout.

MCP_DEFAULT_MAX_CHARS.description: Default maximum characters returned for file reads/searches.

MCP_GIT_FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Timeout in milliseconds for the git fetch command.

servers.description: An MCP server (stdio + HTTP/SSE) that fetches video transcripts/subtitles via yt-dlp, with pagination for large responses. Supports YouTube, Twitter/X, Instagram, TikTok, Twitch, Vimeo, Facebook, Bilibili, VK, Dailymotion. Whisper fallback — transcribes audio when subtitles are unavailable (local or OpenAI API). MCP_HOST.description: The host on which to run the MCP HTTP/SSE server. Defaults to 0.0.0.0.

MCP_PORT.description: The port on which to run the MCP HTTP/SSE server. Defaults to 4200.

CACHE_MODE.description: Set to 'redis' to enable Redis caching for subtitles and metadata to reduce yt-dlp calls.

MCP_AUTH_TOKEN.description: Bearer token for MCP HTTP authentication; used to secure the SSE/HTTP endpoints.

N8N_PROXY_HOPS.description: Number of proxy hops to trust if running behind a reverse proxy (e.g., set to '1' for common setups).

CACHE_REDIS_URL.description: Redis connection string used when CACHE_MODE is set to 'redis'.

WHISPER_API_KEY.description: API key required when using the Whisper API for transcribing audio when subtitles are unavailable.

COOKIES_FILE_PATH.description: Path to a cookies.txt file in Netscape format to handle restricted, age-gated, or sign-in required videos.
